title: Chart your data in conversation with Claude before you commit to a reading
description: Upload a CSV and Claude builds the correlation grid inline, flagging the patterns worth a second look. The flags are a starting point — you click into what's interesting and the conversation goes from there.
prompt: Show me what this data is telling me. I'm looking for the strongest relationships in here. Can you give me a correlation matrix and let me click into any pair to see the scatter? Flag anything that surprises you. Don't hold back on making this readable; I'm presenting this to a committee.
steps: Describe the task: Upload data and ask Claude to show relationships
Give Claude context: Upload the CSV file as required context
What Claude creates: Builds correlation grid with flagged patterns
Follow up prompts: Click into visuals for deeper analysis, ask Claude to write reports, quiz yourself on findings
prerequisites: Google Drive connector (optional, for Google Sheets access)
notes: Prompt shown on page; custom visuals (correlation matrix/scatter) generated inline in chat.
